# A02-S01: Project framework

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Hope everything is good with you!

I have sent my PhD application about AI art and updated our project proposal with the discussed details and extra expenses that we can apply for from foundations.

There are just a couple of practical things I thought we could agree on:

- I would like a list of which MindFutures media I can publish content on.

- Also, I thought we could agree on 1-2 days in mid-February when I will be in Taastrup? Then I could hold some meetings with all of you: [████] Would probably be a good idea so we can agree on some structures thoroughly :-)

- Also clarifying who I should contact continuously in the project in connection with various initiatives.

Also attached my PhD application. If there is anything you find interesting, we could get a head start on AI art activism together.

Looking forward to getting started soon!
